
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/22869617" title="发布于 2026-09-07 10:15">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">java 多线程开发系列之八：玩转多线程（线程的中断）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">之前的线程协作，讲的是通过wait和notify方法，多线程之间进行互相条件唤醒的办法。除此之外我们还需要进行中断操作。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><em>等待和唤醒可参考前文https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/22770136</em></span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">设想这样一个场景：长工在给地主家干活，日出而作，日落而息。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">思路很简单： 长工线程的伪代码</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span>   <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run (){
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>       <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>       <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (time 早于 日出){
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>           <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">继续休息
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>           <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">continue;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>       <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (time 早于 日落){
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>           <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">继续工作
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>           <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">continue;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">时间属于日落
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">结束工作
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">return;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">     }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>   }</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">这就是最典型的通过标志位状态来中断线程的操作。除了开发人员之外，java本身也给线程类内置了一个中断状态的标记变量。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Interrupt state of the thread - read/written directly by JVM </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">volatile</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> interrupted;</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">注释的意思：这是线程的中断状态，读写都是由JVM直接操纵的。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">线程可以通过这个标记，来check自身的状态。并且针对这个变量，jdk提供了几个核心方法，供开发人员直接使用：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>（1）中断这个线程，注意这是实例方法，所中断的线程也就是这个线程实例。</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>&nbsp; &nbsp; public void interrupt()&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>（2）查看这个线程的中断标记，注意这是实例方法，所查看的线程标记变量也就是这个线程实例内置的中断标记。</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>&nbsp; &nbsp; public boolean isInterrupted()</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>（3）查看线程的标记变量，注意这是一个静态方法，其所中断的线程也就是当前执行这个方法的线程currentThread。并且这个方法会清除标记，因此作者在命名时加了ed，表示是否过去被中断过。</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>&nbsp; &nbsp; public static boolean interrupted()</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&nbsp; &nbsp; 顺便依次看下源码：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> interrupt() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span> !=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread.currentThread()) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            checkAccess();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> thread may be blocked in an I/O operation</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">synchronized</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (blockerLock) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>                 Interruptible b =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> blocker;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (b != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>                     interrupted = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>                     interrupt0();  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> inform VM of interrupt</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>                     b.interrupt(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>                     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         interrupted = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> inform VM of interrupt</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        interrupt0();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>     
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">native</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> interrupt0();</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"> 这个方法的大致逻辑是：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">    先判断中断当前方法的线程是不是就是当前线程，</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">    如果不是话，check一下安全设置，检查是否可以跨线程中断其它线程，如果有问题这里会抛出一个运行时异常 SecurityException。如果安全检查也没问题，判断当前线程是否处于I/O阻塞中。如果是的话就打断线程的I/O阻塞（阻塞的地方通常会抛出IOException相关的异常。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">另外通常只有nio 的阻塞才会中断，传统的io不会响应中断，read write 方法依然会阻塞住），设置标记位interrupted为true，表示被中断了。并且调用native 方法interrupt0，让jvm来处理中断的具体操作。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">    如果是当前线程，或者没有处于阻塞中的话，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )这里直接设置标记位interrupted为true，并且调用native 方法interrupt0即可。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">然后是获取中断状态，这里很简单，直接拿状态变量：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isInterrupted() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> interrupted;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span>     }</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">接着是获取并清理中断状态：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> interrupted() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>         Thread t =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentThread();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> interrupted =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t.interrupted;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> We may have been interrupted the moment after we read the field,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> so only clear the field if we saw that it was set and will return
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> true; otherwise we could lose an interrupt.</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (interrupted) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>             t.interrupted = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            clearInterruptEvent();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> interrupted;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">native</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> clearInterruptEvent();</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">核心逻辑是：取出当前线程t，以及当前线程的中断状态，如果当前线程的中断标记位true。那么就设置其为false，<strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">并且清理中断事件：告诉jvm，底层未处理的pending状态的中断信号清理掉。（后文红色字体会说到）</span></strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">知道了这些api的作用，我们来看一个简单的例子：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptStudy {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> main(String[] args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>         Thread t1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Thread(() -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>                 System.out.println("do sth"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>             System.out.println("task end, interrupt state " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        t1.start();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         Thread.sleep(1000L<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        t1.interrupt();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        t1.join();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">输出结果如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Connected to the target VM, address: '127.0.0.1:53895', transport: 'socket'
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
....
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
task end, interrupt state </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Disconnected from the target VM, address: </span>'127.0.0.1:53895', transport: 'socket'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

Process finished with exit code </span>0</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">这样子就可以通过中断标记，和线程进行交互从而中断线程了。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">再改为使用静态方法：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptStudy {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> main(String[] args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>         Thread t1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Thread(() -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Thread.interrupted()) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>                 System.out.println("do sth"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>             System.out.println("task end, interrupt state " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        t1.start();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         Thread.sleep(10L<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        t1.interrupt();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        t1.join();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">输出结果如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Connected to the target VM, address: '127.0.0.1:60872', transport: 'socket'
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
....
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
task end, interrupt state </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Disconnected from the target VM, address: </span>'127.0.0.1:60872', transport: 'socket'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

Process finished with exit code </span>0</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">发现中断以后，重置了中断标记，因此就返回false。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">但是java的中断能力远不止此，如果仅仅是这样，那也太容易了。还记得上篇文章的wait么，以及更早之前的sleep，如果线程处于这种状态，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )无法自行的check 中断状态怎么办。没关系jvm 会自行的帮你唤醒，抛出一个InterruptedException。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">同时在抛出异常之前，jvm还会帮你做两件事：清理标记，重新尝试获取锁。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">请看下边这个例子：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptExStudy {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">final</span> Object lock = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Object();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> main(String[] args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>         Thread t1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Thread(() -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">synchronized</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (lock) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>                 System.out.println("task  start"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>                     System.out.println("task  do sth"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    lock.wait();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>                 } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (InterruptedException e) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>                     System.out.println("task catch interrupt ex ,state: " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>                 System.out.println("task end "<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        t1.start();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>         Thread.sleep(1000L<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">synchronized</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (lock) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>             System.out.println("before notify, t1 state-0 :" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t1.isInterrupted());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            t1.interrupt();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span>             System.out.println("before notify, t1 state-1 :" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t1.isInterrupted());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        t1.join();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">输出如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Connected to the target VM, address: '127.0.0.1:51128', transport: 'socket'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
task  start
task  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
before notify, t1 state</span>-0 :<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
before notify, t1 state</span>-1 :<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
task </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span> interrupt ex ,state: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
task end 
Disconnected from the target VM, address: </span>'127.0.0.1:51128', transport: 'socket'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

Process finished with exit code </span>0</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">大致逻辑是这样的：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">主线程启动t1线程，t1线程抢到锁，t1处于wait状态（同时释放锁）， 主线程抢到锁，主线程中断t1，t1需要再次抢到锁才能抛出中断异常，</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">当后续在抛出中断异常的时候，t1内部的中断标记也被重置了。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>这样子即使线程处于join/wait/sleep等状态下，无法主动check状态，我们也可以通过抛出异常的形式，来中断线程了。同时根据前文中的jdk源码，也可以知道，即使在IO等待的状态下，也会被中断。而一开始说的api：interrupted()中的源码中，会调用clearInterruptEvent() 清理中断事件，其作用就是为了清理这些中断异常抛出等事件，保证虽然标记被恢复为false，对应的中断事件也都被清理干净了。</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><span style="color: rgba(51, 153, 102, 1)"><strong>另外还需要注意的是，中断是一个累加状态，也就是说即使当前线程还没开始阻塞（join/wait/sleep/io阻塞等），一旦被标记为中断，即使后边再遇到阻塞场景，也一样被中断。</strong></span>来看这个例子：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> * @discription
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptEx1Study {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">final</span> Object lock = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Object();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">volatile</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> time_out = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> main(String[] args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>         Thread sleepTask = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Thread(() -&gt; { <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">睡眠线程</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>                 Thread.sleep(2000L<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>             } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (InterruptedException e) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> do sth</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>             time_out = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>         Thread t1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Thread(() -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>             System.out.println("t1 start ,state:" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            sleepTask.start();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">time_out) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">wait sleep task</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span>             System.out.println("t1 wait sleep task end,state:" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">synchronized</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (lock) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span>                 System.out.println("t1 task  start"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span>                     System.out.println("t1 task  do sth"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    lock.wait();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span>                 } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (InterruptedException e) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span>                     System.out.println("t1 catch interrupt ex ,state: " +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">37</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">38</span>                 System.out.println("task end "<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">39</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">40</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">41</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">42</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        t1.start();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">43</span>         Thread.sleep(500L); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">等待t1拉起睡眠线程</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">44</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">synchronized</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (lock) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">45</span>             System.out.println("before notify, t1 state-0 :" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t1.isInterrupted());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">46</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            t1.interrupt();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">47</span>             System.out.println("before notify, t1 state-1 :" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t1.isInterrupted());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">48</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">49</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        t1.join();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">50</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">51</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">52</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">大致逻辑是t1启动以后，先等待2s（通过等待另外一个线程修改完标记来做到），</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">2s结束后t1才开始获取锁，在获取锁之前主线程先拿到锁并且打上中断标记，并且释放锁。(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">此时t1抢到锁，开始等待，此时由于之前已经被打上中断印记了，因此这里会直接抛出异常，结束任务。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">实际输出如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Connected to the target VM, address: '127.0.0.1:52345', transport: 'socket'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
t1 start ,state:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
before notify, t1 state</span>-0 :<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
before notify, t1 state</span>-1 :<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
t1 wait sleep task end,state:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
t1 task  start
t1 task  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sth
t1 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span> interrupt ex ,state: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
task end 
Disconnected from the target VM, address: </span>'127.0.0.1:52345', transport: 'socket'</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">但是这里又会有一个新的问题，如果线程t1内部逻辑很复杂，方法套方法，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )出现了多个wait/sleep等阻塞动作怎么办，我们本意是希望终止线程，结果到处阻塞，我总不能在外边写一个while循环，不断的打断线程吧。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">大可不必，一般推荐的办法是，在catch到终止异常时，判断是否真的要终止，还是需要继续执行剩余代码（一般后端守护线程都需要继续再执行）。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">如果确定要终止，则在catch中直接调用Thread.currentThread().interrupt();直接自己给自己再打一个终止标记即可。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">这样即使后边再遇到check 或者 阻塞的地方，都会直接按照已中断继续的来处理。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">因此当有interrupt方法时，我们最好不要直接catch Exception 这样的大异常，使得维护阶段，忘记这里可能线程被中断，从而继续跑任务。</span></p>

</div>
<div id="MySignature" role="contentinfo">
    <p style="background: #C0FFFF; padding: 10px; border: 1px dashed #E0E0E0; font: 100% 微软雅黑; color: #F00; text-align: center">
如果你觉得写的不错，欢迎转载和点赞。
转载时请保留作者署名jilodream/王若伊_恩赐解脱（博客链接：http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/</p>
</div>
